text:
Nora: tiny design ask from yesterday's usability session — users on mobile wanted more tactile feedback that generation is progressing. not full-screen loaders, just subtle cues.
Maya P: interesting. are we talking haptic, audio chime, or visual micro-affordances?
Nora: all three maybe, but opt-in. default: visual micro-affordance + optional haptic on supported devices. example: a small left-edge pulse + 1 vibration on first chunk.
Ethan: backend already marks chunk flushes. we can surface `chunk_event` in stream. haptic is client-only (navigator.vibrate). need opt-in and pref in Settings.
Rhea (design): call the visual cue "progress filament" in spec. 1px vertical filament on left that brightens per chunk then fades quickly. accessibility: not only visual — use aria-live text "Receiving partial response" on first chunk.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) `aria-live=polite` for partial updates, 2) vibrate only when user has given permission and `prefers-reduced-motion` disabled, 3) audible chime optional and muteable, 4) ensure visual filament has sufficient contrast in high-contrast mode.
Maya P: microcopy: Settings toggle name: "Haptics for streaming" with subtitle "Vibrate on new response chunks". For audio: "Play chime on new partials". Use verb-first language.
Ethan: dev note: stream payload additions: `chunk_event:true`, `chunk_index:int`, `remaining_est:int` optional. client computes tokens/sec and can show a compact sparkline near token counter.
Nora: token counter idea — make it tappable on mobile to expand into a tiny modal that shows "used / est" and a mini sparkline and an explanation: "Estimates may vary". helps with decisions on waiting vs interrupt.
Rhea (design): prompt library tweak: add "quick-swap" gestures on mobile: long-press a prompt to preview and swipe up to insert. while streaming shrink prompt carousel to a single row. pinned prompts show a pin badge. keyboard accessible equivalents on desktop.
Maya P: copy for quick-swap preview: "Preview prompt" and for swipe insert: "Insert prompt". ensure tooltips read well when translated.
a11y-bot: also recommend focus trap when prompt preview opens and a clear close button labelled "Close preview". voiceover should read "Prompt preview dialog".
Ethan: feature flag `playground_stream_haptics_v1` to gate client haptics/audio. will add stream flags and settings pref.
Nora: can we run a 5-person mobile usability test focused on haptics + filament? want to ensure it's helpful, not distracting.
Maya P: yes, i'll run it. small microcopy panel for settings language too.
Deploy-bot: sandbox build 2026-07-12T09:42:18 deployed (featureflag: playground_stream_haptics_v1).
